system.description:
You spin your weapon slowly as it draws anxiety from those around you eliciting different effects based on which Chain rank you are in.

Chain 1: All creatures in range, must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save the next time they take damage from a flail weapon or Bukijutsu that uses a Flail they gain 1 rank of Demoralized.

Chain 2: All creatures in range, must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save the next time they take damage from a flail weapon or Bukijutsu that uses a Flail they gain 2 ranks of Concussed.

Chain 3: All creatures in range, must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save the next time they take damage from a flail weapon or Bukijutsu that uses a Flail they gain 3 ranks of Dazzled.
